samplerDiagnosis.cause: Each transaction seals the preceding capture. With16–24second capture intervals, the newest sealed observation can briefly be older than30seconds before the next seal. These checked observations retained continuous valid historical timestamps; reduced current coverage was temporary sealing lag.
samplerDiagnosis.restriction: Do not extend timestamps, TTL or carry. Unconditional samples without a newer INDEX cannot seal the pending capture.
